note: Keys are source-native USFM references BOOK.CHAPTER.VERSE (verse may be a source range such as 15-16). Spans exclude the superscript verse label. BOOK.CHAPTER.d is a chapter-initial superscription and BOOK.CHAPTER.d+N one following verse N; BOOK.CHAPTER.pre is chapter-initial text before verse 1; SIR.PROLOGUE is the Sirach prologue.
